title: Expanded Earth
content: A few short weeks ago I dreamt of stowing away on an exotic ship of some sort in the cargo bay with a small group of familiar "friends" - no one I can recall, perhaps my husband was there, I feel like he was. Anyway, We snuck up to the lounge areas above and blended in with staff or as passengers and it was very luxurious, kinda felt like that blimp from Indiana Jones last crusade. At one point I could look out the window to the land below and it was beyond Earth. It looked like earth, but felt like an expansion of the landscape that I've known in this life as Earth. I had dejavu in this dream remembering a time before looking at digital maps of more "foreign than foreign as we know it" continents and oceans. Not alien or other worldy... just foreign is how it felt... I have no idea what I was doing there... I never do upon waking. It always feels important though. Ps. I'm not a flat earther uh, exactly, however the idea of this expanse I've seen in my dreams kinda feels relative to some flat earther videos Ive seen recently on my TikTok feed that made me go "hmmmmmm. thats interesting."
